correctness.rationale: The barycentric gradients give sum_i S_i u_i=0 and identify the unique cofactor vector of the normal matrix. Expanding the augmented determinant of the translated projected feet yields a homogeneous degree-n polynomial in signed distances with cofactors proportional to S_i. The determinant of the remaining barycentric gradients fixes the proportionality constant exactly, producing the displayed volume factor. At A_k, the n other signed distances are independent affine coordinates, d_k is a nonzero altitude, and the first nonzero homogeneous part has degree n-1 with positive nonzero coefficients, proving exact multiplicity. The deterministic verifier independently checks dimensions 2 through 6 and the planar Euler specialization.
